note: Deep-dive #12. Hub changes can take 2 to 4 hours: record hub and later screens after the wait. Browser sign-in windows open during the provision run (owner signs in as labadmin, no passwords or codes on screen).
prepare: Register-PnPEntraIDAppForInteractiveLogin -ApplicationName 'contoso-intranet-pnp' -Tenant $env:MG_TENANT_DOMAIN   # owner signs in, grants admin consent, notes the client id
# clean slate: remove leftovers of a rehearsal (idempotent)

Get-PnPSiteDesign | Where-Object Title -eq 'Contoso intranet site' | ForEach-Object { Remove-PnPSiteDesign -Identity $_.Id -Force }; Get-PnPSiteScript | Where-Object Title -eq 'Contoso intranet site script' | ForEach-Object { Remove-PnPSiteScript -Identity $_.Id -Force }

# manual: build the flow 'News request approval' in DEV as labadmin (trigger SharePoint When an item is created on News Requests; Approvals Start and wait; Condition; Update item Approved / Rejected) after the provision screen has created the list; assigned to sam.demo; mgl_CommsApprover = sam.demo's e-mail; compare with flow/news-approval.definition.json

# manual: Teams admin center > Teams apps > Setup policies > Global > Pinned apps: add the SharePoint / Viva Connections app (on camera in the viva screen); SharePoint admin center > Settings > Home sites

screens.name: provision
also: Expected tables: WhatIf (Site x4, Hub, Association x3, HubNavigation x4, HomeSite), then Created/Registered/Associated/Added/Set, then every line Exists, then Test-Intranet all Pass. The tenant name and client id are held in environment variables and are not printed.

screens.name: hub
steps: Open the Contoso Home site: hub navigation across the top (People and Culture, IT Help, Operations, Expenses)
Click People and Culture: the same navigation bar is on the department site
SharePoint admin center > Sites > Active sites: Contoso Home as hub with its three associated department sites
mask: tenant name in the address bar and the admin center URL

screens.name: flow
steps: As labadmin open the flow News request approval in the designer (three actions and the condition)
As alex.demo add an item to News Requests on the hub site: Title, Summary, Department; status Submitted
As sam.demo answer the real approval in the Approvals app in Teams (or the e-mail, whichever arrives) with a comment
Refresh the list item: News status Approved and the message filled
Back as labadmin: run history shows Succeeded
mask: Power Automate environment URL and id
e-mail domains (lab users only: keep alex.demo and sam.demo)

screens.name: viva
steps: Teams admin center > Teams apps > Setup policies > Global > Pinned apps: the SharePoint / Viva Connections app added
SharePoint admin center > Settings > Home sites: Contoso Home (Draft, then enabled)
Teams desktop as alex.demo: the app pinned on the left bar, the home site open inside Teams

teardown: Get-PnPSiteDesign | Where-Object Title -eq 'Contoso intranet site' | ForEach-Object { Remove-PnPSiteDesign -Identity $_.Id -Force }; Get-PnPSiteScript | Where-Object Title -eq 'Contoso intranet site script' | ForEach-Object { Remove-PnPSiteScript -Identity $_.Id -Force }
